result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred 12-month software conformance warranty and includes professional/workmanlike services, applicable-law compliance, a malicious-code warranty, and repair, replacement/re-performance or refund remedies. However, it provides no warranty period for the Hosting or Support Services; the playbook requires 90 days, or at least the 30-day fallback. The margin comment acknowledging that fallback does not cure the omission from the clause. The additions are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted without materially disturbing unrelated terms.
